_comment: Golden set for `cargo run --features semantic-search --bin semantic-recall`.
Each entry is a question a developer could plausibly type, paired with the
file paths that legitimately answer it. A query scores a hit when any
expected path appears in the top 10. `expect` values are matched as path
suffixes, so they must be long enough to be unambiguous.
The set deliberately mixes two kinds of query: those whose wording overlaps
the identifiers in the code (BM25 should win or tie) and those phrased in
pure intent with no shared vocabulary (only the vector side can find them).
That mix is the point: it shows where the semantic engine earns its cost.
Review rule: never add an entry whose expected file you have not opened.

queries.note: JWT decoding and expiry validation, plus the request-side extractor.

queries.note: Text confidence heuristic over the first bytes.
